title: Particle Motion, Velocity, and Direction Changes
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A particle moves along a coordinate axis with position s(t) = t^3 - 6t^2 + 9t for t >= 0. Find velocity, acceleration, when the particle is at rest, and when it is speeding up.

steps.title: Compute Velocity and Acceleration Functions
steps.explanation: Differentiate s(t) once for velocity and twice for acceleration.
steps.why: Kinematics definitions: v = s' and a = s''.

steps.title: Determine When Particle is at Rest
steps.mathExpression: v(t) = 0 \implies 3(t - 1)(t - 3) = 0 \implies t = 1 \text{ s and } t = 3 \text{ s}
steps.explanation: A particle is instantaneously at rest when its velocity is zero.

steps.title: Analyze Speeding Up Condition
steps.mathExpression: v(t)a(t) > 0: \quad t \in (1, 2) \implies v < 0, a < 0 \implies \text{speeding up}; \quad t > 3 \implies v > 0, a > 0 \implies \text{speeding up}
steps.explanation: An object speeds up when velocity and acceleration share the same sign.
steps.why: Same sign of velocity and acceleration accelerates magnitude of velocity.
